name: 45315 · Clayton, OH
findings: ZIP 45315 (Clayton) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45315 (Clayton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45315 (Clayton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
